name: Scrolling, panels that fit, a movable preview and drag to place

comments.text: Dean (2026-11-26 21:15 AWST): scrolling in most panels; the Silhouettes panel and the asset browser don't scroll properly (asset browser scrolls left to right instead of filling downwards in a grid; Silhouettes panel doesn't scroll at all). Couldn't move the Silhouettes panel's dock position: it opened somewhere else and couldn't be undocked or moved. Panels don't fit properly when extended (screenshots: outliner rows and details fields stay narrow in a wide panel; the preview's buttons are cut off). Move the viewer (asset preview) to its own movable panel. Placing should be by dragging from a panel into the scene, positioned where you drop it, rather than starting at 0,0,0.

Done 2026-11-26: cards wrap on <inline> in vertical scrolls, scrolls stretch their content, Silhouettes and the asset preview are movable panels, placing is by dragging (also out of floating panels). D-287, D-288. Verified in the cloud editor only.
